title: Page arithmetic
description:
Work with 4096-byte pages, without `div`:

| Function | Returns |
|---|---|
| `round_page(n)` | `n` rounded up to a multiple of 4096 (0 stays 0) |
| `pages_for(n)` | how many pages `n` bytes need |
| `page_offset(address)` | where in its page an address is (0 to 4095) |

starter.solution.asm:
round_page:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

pages_for:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

page_offset:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
round_page:
        lea     rax, [rdi + 4095]
        and     rax, -4096
        ret

pages_for:
        lea     rax, [rdi + 4095]
        shr     rax, 12
        ret

page_offset:
        mov     rax, rdi
        and     eax, 4095
        ret

hints: Adding 4095 before clearing the low 12 bits (`and rax, -4096`) rounds up; shifting right by 12 divides by 4096 (lesson 8.04).
The offset is just the low 12 bits: `and` with 4095.
rules: Use shifts and masks, not division.
unitTests:
test "rounding"
    round_page(0) == 0
    round_page(1) == 4096
    round_page(4096) == 4096
    round_page(8193) == 12288
test "pages"
    pages_for(0) == 0
    pages_for(1) == 1
    pages_for(4096) == 1
    pages_for(1000000) == 245
test "offsets"
    page_offset(0x12345) == 0x345
    page_offset(4096) == 0
    page_offset(4095) == 4095

rules.message: Use shifts and masks, not division.
